cd tests/fuzz

./fuzz.py build all

for target in $(./fuzz.py list); do
    cp "$target" "$OUT"

    options=default.options
    if [ -f "$target.options" ]; then
        options="$target.options"
    fi
    cp "$options" "$OUT/$target.options"

    if [ -f "$target.dict" ]; then
        cp "$target.dict" "$OUT"
    fi

    cp "$SRC/${target}_seed_corpus.zip" "$OUT"
done
